source.note: tokenless-empty-forms: the empty description block lies between `direction` and its value, inside a name of two name parts, and this specification rejects the input. mermaid.js reads no token for it, and the block keeps its direction rule from matching, so it reads `direction` and the value as the two name parts of a member statement: with the label, it declares the class `directionLR` with the member `x`, as the reference input `directionLR : x` does.
